name: claude-session-sync
description: Continue a Claude Code session on another device. Sync your session history through GitHub, iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive and more, and choose which sessions to bring over.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reads and writes ~/.claude and runs git.

enumDescriptions: Sign in with GitHub; a private claude-sessions repository is created automatically.
Dropbox, signed in directly in the browser (no Dropbox app needed).
OneDrive, signed in directly in the browser (no OneDrive app needed).
A folder kept in sync by a storage's own app: iCloud Drive, Google Drive, MEGA, pCloud, Box, Proton Drive, Nextcloud…
claudeSessionSync.mode.markdownDescription: How sessions travel between devices. Use **Claude Sync: Choose sync method** to change it.

claudeSessionSync.syncFolder.markdownDescription: Cloud-storage method: the folder that holds the sessions. Filled in when you pick a storage on first use; you can also set any synced folder by hand.

claudeSessionSync.deviceName.markdownDescription: Name of this device in the storage: its sessions are exported to their own folder under this name, and other devices choose it when importing. Empty = the computer's host name.

claudeSessionSync.repoUrl.markdownDescription: Own-git method: URL of a **private** git repository that stores the transcripts (`https://…`, `ssh://…` or `git@host:owner/repo.git`).

claudeSessionSync.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Sessions bigger than this are **not pushed** (and are reported). GitHub rejects any file over 100 MB, and one such file fails the whole push.

claudeSessionSync.maxSessionAgeDays.markdownDescription: Push only sessions modified within this many days. `0` = no limit. A pull always takes everything the repository holds.

claudeSessionSync.projectKey.markdownDescription: The same value on every device matches a project that has no git remote (or different remotes). Empty = the git remote, otherwise the folder name.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
